posts.text:
“一个转发顶几个赞”，这类 X 流量配方，第一步就读错了代码。

X 公开算法的权重，乘的是「这个读者点赞、转发的预测概率」，不是你已经拿到的互动数。

同一条帖，对不同读者，分数可以不同。

把排序公式当成互动兑换表，方向就错了。

源码：https://github.com/xai-org/x-algorithm/blob/77d431aabf409ca1c1eed9bec7e2183f7c914e23/xai-value-model/scoring.rs#L28
posts.mechanism_hypothesis: Correcting a verifiable misconception with inspectable primary evidence may improve relevant-reader sharing compared with generic advice. Untested on this account.
posts.post_reason: Current primary-source finding; no added joke, fictional experience or engagement claim.

comparison_design: Observational pilot only; no randomized reader assignment. Baseline snapshot windows missing, so no causal or performance conclusion.
